sources.search_volume: ESTIMATED from data/demand_weights.json (not real search volume)
sources.inventory: data/inventory.json built from live treebo.com pages (see data/inventory_notes.json)
sources.prices: inventory price_from = lower bound of the hotel page's priceRange (brand-tier band)

excluded_filters.free-breakfast: Treebo deliberately excludes Free Breakfast from amenity pages (treebo/webapp/common/constants/common_constants.py:285). Checked as a page issue instead (breakfast_not_stated).

ranking: opportunities.json lists locality/landmark opportunities first, then city-level. Each level is scored separately (demand scaled within the level); see cities.*.coverage.ranking.

issue_confidence.outdated_price: low - prices change daily and the live price is a brand-tier band
issue_confidence.no_quick_answer: medium - heuristic on the first About paragraph
issue_confidence.breakfast_not_stated: medium - amenities come from hotel page structured data

score_formula: 100 x demand(volume / max volume in city) x inventory(min(hotels,5)/5) x gap(1.0 competitor has page, else 0.8) x ai_invisibility(1 - mention rate)
